headline: A design fits the current planning estimate

recommendation.label: Oxford Nanopore
recommendation.instrument: MinION / GridION, one DNA flow cell
recommendation.read_length: 25 kb DNA planning target; distribution depends on extraction
recommendation.error_mode: Basecaller/chemistry-dependent substitutions and indels, with systematic context and homopolymer errors; simplex and duplex are distinct.
recommendation.capability_note: 15–35 Gb is the published typical DNA output. The 25-kb and 100-kb read-length targets and 72-hour schedule are assumptions. Do not apply this DNA yield to direct RNA.

cost.range_interpretation: Sensitivity range, not a statistical confidence interval.
cost.provenance: Single FLO-MIN114 DNA flow cell costs US$840 in the official U.S. store on 2026-10-06. $33.60/Gb is derived at the assumed 25-Gb yield. Preparation, device allocation, analysis and taxes are additional.

detection.interpretation: Read length plus depth is a planning filter. It does not predict contig N50, phase accuracy or assembly completeness.

reasons: 40× effective depth is an explicitly provisional assembly target; genome complexity changes it.
caveats: A single mean or target read length does not guarantee repeat bridging; confirm the full read-length distribution and spanning-read count.

alternatives.label: Illumina short reads
alternatives.error_mode: Substitution errors, sequence-dependent GC/PCR bias; repeats and paralogs create ambiguous short-read alignments.
alternatives.capability_note: The 25B envelope applies to this selected configuration. Small projects require pooling or a different instrument; a whole flow cell has a large minimum cost.

cost.range_interpretation: Sensitivity range, not a statistical confidence interval.
cost.provenance: Reagent-only $2/Gb benchmark comes from $200 per 100-Gb genome; $16,000/run is derived at 8,000 Gb. Shared $5/Gb, prep, instrument and compute amounts are project assumptions.

alternatives.error_mode: Consensus reduces single-pass errors; residual errors, allelic bias, DNA quality and hard regions still matter.
alternatives.capability_note: Yield assumes high-quality 15–20 kb DNA. RNA/isoform library yields do not follow the DNA envelope; RNA cost output is an exploratory allocation.

methodology.sampling_model: Poisson depth with independent alternate observations; D is mean mapped, retained depth and f is allele fraction.
methodology.cost_formula: sum(library, QC, sequencing, instrument, compute, storage) × (1 + contingency)
methodology.selection: Lowest estimated total cost among compatible designs meeting the requested budget and sample structure; if none fit, report the least costly compatible requirement and its gap.
methodology.floor_basis: Depth floors and RNA fragment targets are explicit planning priors. The measured bacterial mapping pilot has insufficient endpoint coverage to replace them.

metadata.scientific_name: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

illumina.caveat: SAM provenance must specify aligner/version/preset. Primary SAM CIGAR M/= /X bases count toward depth at the MAPQ threshold; MAPQ255 is unavailable and excluded. D/N gaps, secondary/supplementary alignments and preflagged QCFAIL/DUP records do not contribute to coverage; mapped-read counts still include mapped primary QCFAIL/DUP records. No duplicate marking or paired-overlap correction is performed. MAPQ is aligner-specific and not independently calibrated here. NM/(M+I+=+X) is edit distance per aligned query base, includes sequencing errors and biological differences and treats deletions differently from identity. It is not an independent base-error truth benchmark. Internal QC selects accepted molecules from raw input, but trimmed tails/adapters remain in the external raw-SAM intervals. Nominal bases use original supplied input length. Acquired read prefixes can be ordered/biased and are not random samples of the complete archived run.

plateau.criterion: At least95% reference breadth>=1x and consecutive absolute gains<1 percentage point; requires two adjacent increments, measured on this subset only.

illumina.mapping_rate_depth_caveat: Mapping each read uses a fixed reference and fixed algorithm; removing other reads does not causally degrade per-read mapping quality. Changes in sample mapping rate are composition/sampling variability. Breadth and depth are the meaningful depth-dependent endpoints.

saturation.caveat: Coverage of a bacterial reference is not a variant-calling, expression, assembly or structural-variant accuracy benchmark. Fractions are nested within seed; ranges describe only downsampling randomness, not biological uncertainty.

quality_metric_definitions.mean_mapq: Unweighted mean available MAPQ over mapped primary reads; MAPQ255 excluded, low MAPQ included. A placement-confidence heuristic, not calibrated truth accuracy.
quality_metric_definitions.mean_alignment_edit_distance_per_aligned: Unweighted per-read mean NM/(M+I+=+X) for mapped primary SAM records with NM. Sequencing errors and reference biological differences are confounded; deletions enter NM but not query denominator. Educational short fallback uses its verification edit-distance/query-length; long fallback is null.
quality_metric_definitions.depth_interpretation: Per-read scores are reused from a fixed SAM: differences across subset fractions are read-composition/sampling changes, not causal loss of alignment quality from removing unrelated reads.

resources.scalability: FASTQ QC streams; retained per-molecule mappings and sampled reference seed index remain in memory. Full-scale workflow uses minimap2, coordinate-sorted BAM and samtools depth instead.

evidence.recommendation_use: Diagnostic comparison only; cannot validate calling depth.
limitations: Reference breadth of primary alignments with MAPQ ≥20 is not variant recall, expression power or assembly completeness.
A plateau below complete breadth may reflect reference mismatch, repeats or aligner limits.
A bacterial pilot cannot establish human, RNA-seq or assembly depth requirements.
Repeated downsampling seeds measure sampling variability, not biological variability.
This is a reproducible research planning model. End-to-end variant sensitivity, expression power and assembly performance have not been validated.
Mapping and usable fractions are editable assumptions, not predictions from organism names. Replace them with QC and alignment results from your library.
Mean depth hides uneven coverage, duplicate molecules and inaccessible regions. The allele model excludes sequencing errors, strand bias and caller filters.

Vendor reagent benchmarks check unit arithmetic. Independent NUSeq service checks report configuration/scope differences and substantial preparation-price mismatches; they do not validate the project total.
The cost range is a ±30% sensitivity scenario by default, not a measured error distribution; quotations and atypical sample preparation can fall outside it.

sources.title: AWS S3 pricing
sources.supports: Storage depends on region, class, retention and requests. $0.023/GB-month here is an illustrative U.S. Standard assumption; verify the applicable region.

sources.title: AWS EC2 On-Demand pricing
sources.supports: Compute is metered by instance duration. The advisor's $0.35/instance-hour is an editable budget assumption, not an EC2 quote.

sources.title: Oxford Nanopore U.S. flow-cell store
sources.supports: Single FLO-MIN114 DNA flow cell US$840 on 2026-10-06; preparation, device, tax and labor excluded.

sources.title: Northwestern NUSeq FY26 external service prices
sources.supports: Independent U.S. external academic rates. NovaSeq X Plus 10B PE150 lane: $1,873.75 for 1.0–1.2 billion pairs; 25B PE150 lane: $3,750 for 2.5–3.0 billion pairs. DNA prep <24 samples: $240; stranded mRNA prep <96: $198; ONT prep: $437.50. Service rates differ from reagent prices.

cost_validation.scope: Arithmetic consistency check against vendor reagent-only benchmark; not independent or end-to-end validation.
Arithmetic conversion using 3-Gb genome × 20; not independent or end-to-end validation.

cost_validation.name: NUSeq 10B PE150 external academic lane
cost_validation.scope: Service price includes sequencing and instrument operation. Compare with model sequencing + instrument, excluding preparation/QC/compute/storage/contingency. Different flow-cell configuration (10B vs configured 25B) limits direct equivalence; minimum billable unit is a whole lane.

cost_validation.name: NUSeq 25B PE150 external academic lane
cost_validation.scope: Independent external service benchmark for the same 25B PE150 configuration. Service sequencing includes instrument operation, so do not add instrument cost to the published service price. A full lane is the minimum published unit; shared allocation remains an assumption.

cost_validation.name: NUSeq DNA library prep <24 samples
cost_validation.scope: Preparation service alone. Project assumption excludes service labor/overhead; a mismatch is expected and should constrain interpretation of the project total.

cost_validation.name: NUSeq stranded mRNA prep <96 samples
cost_validation.scope: Library preparation alone, without sequencing. Not applicable to all RNA library strategies.

cost_validation.name: NUSeq Nanopore long-read library prep
cost_validation.scope: External academic preparation service. The project preparation assumption omits the service's labor and overhead.
